decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers are a core heat-exchanger component, closely tied to the firm's established tube manufacturing, and they survived the 2019 pruning of other launches; the sunk investment in production capability and this central strategic fit favor persisting despite the lack of recent evidence.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes reflect the firm's announced technological direction and specialized tooling investment, and they were retained when peripheral products were dropped, so management is likely to keep them and treat any weak results as temporary.
